title: Complex Conditions and Past Irrealis
summary: Expressing real, hypothetical, counterfactual, and mixed conditions with precise time relationships.
whyItMatters: Advanced conditionals distinguish open possibilities from unlikely hypotheses, unreal past alternatives, and present consequences of past choices.

mentalModel.title: Choose reality status and time
mentalModel.content: First decide whether the condition is open, hypothetical, or counterfactual; then locate condition and result in present, future, or past.

mentalModel.title: The clauses need not share a time
mentalModel.content: A past unreal condition can have a present result, creating a mixed conditional.

ruleBlocks.title: Express open conditions
ruleBlocks.content: Use indicative forms with wenn, falls, sofern, vorausgesetzt dass, or unter der Bedingung, dass.

ruleBlocks.title: Build unreal conditions
ruleBlocks.content: Use Konjunktiv II; for the past, use hätte or wäre plus past participle in both condition and result.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect different time levels
ruleBlocks.content: Combine a past counterfactual condition with a present hypothetical result when the consequence continues now.

examples.de: Sofern unabhängige Prüfungen stattfinden, kann das Verfahren fortgesetzt werden.
examples.en: Provided that independent reviews take place, the process can continue.

examples.de: Wären die Risiken transparenter, ließe sich die Debatte sachlicher führen.
examples.en: If the risks were more transparent, the debate could be conducted more objectively.

examples.de: Hätte man die Warnsignale ernst genommen, wären heute strengere Eingriffe möglicherweise nicht nötig.
examples.en: Had the warning signs been taken seriously, stricter interventions might not be necessary today.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use würde in every clause regardless of the verb.
commonMistakes.correct: Prefer hätte, wäre, könnte, müsste, and simple Konjunktiv II forms where natural.
commonMistakes.reason: These forms are clearer and more idiomatic.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use past irrealis in only one half of a fully past counterfactual.
commonMistakes.correct: Mark both unreal condition and unreal result with Konjunktiv II past.
commonMistakes.reason: Both events are contrary to fact.

comparisons.summary: Future scenarios and ethical safeguards depend on explicit assumptions and counterfactual reasoning.
Debaters use conditionals to test proposals and expose consequences.
